description: Self-hosted, fully offline AI-powered development platform — three-pillar system: Chat Engine, Visual Studio Integration, and Self-Iteration.
pillars: Pillar 1 — Chat Engine: context-aware, multi-turn conversational development assistant
Pillar 2 — Visual Studio Integration: native VSIX extension for Visual Studio 2022
Pillar 3 — Self-Iteration: autonomous roadmap-driven self-build loop

milestones.title: Self-Iteration — Autonomous Self-Build Loop
milestones.description: Arbiter reads its own roadmap, plans implementation steps, writes code, runs tests, and commits changes. Four autonomy modes from Assist to FullAuto.

tasks.title: SelfBuildController: orchestrator that reads roadmap.json, selects next pending task, coordinates pipeline
tasks.notes: SelfBuildController orchestrates the full self-build pipeline (plan → identify → generate → validate → test → commit).

tasks.title: Four autonomy modes: Manual, Assist, SemiAuto, FullAuto — configurable per session
tasks.notes: Four autonomy modes: Manual (read-only), Assist (pauses before apply), SemiAuto (pauses before commit), FullAuto (autonomous).

tasks.title: Task planning: AI generates step-by-step implementation plan for selected roadmap task
tasks.notes: Task planning step: AI generates a numbered step-by-step implementation plan before coding.

tasks.title: File identification: AI identifies which files need to be created or modified for each step
tasks.notes: File identification step: AI identifies which files to create/modify from the plan.

tasks.title: Code generation: AI writes full file content or unified diff for each change
tasks.notes: Code generation step: AI writes a unified diff patch for the identified files.

tasks.title: Syntax validation: Python AST check / dotnet build dry-run before applying changes
tasks.notes: Syntax validation: Python AST check on all modified .py files before running tests.

tasks.title: Test execution: run pytest / dotnet test / npm test after applying changes
tasks.notes: Test execution: pytest run after patch applied; output shown in self-build log.

tasks.title: Iteration loop: if tests fail, AI revises changes up to 3 times before requesting human review
tasks.notes: Iteration loop: rollback and retry up to 3 times on syntax or test failures.

tasks.title: Git commit: structured commit message [arbiter-self-build] <task-id>: <description>
tasks.notes: Structured commit message: [arbiter-self-build] <task_id>: <title>.

tasks.title: Roadmap update: mark task done, add implementation notes, set next task as in_progress
tasks.notes: Roadmap update: marks task done with implementation notes (mode, files, attempts).

tasks.title: Self-build REST API: /self-build/start, /stop, /status, /approve, /reject, /log
tasks.notes: Self-build REST API added to server.py: /self-build/start, /stop, /status, /approve, /reject, /log, /roadmap, /next

tasks.title: Self-build panel in Monaco IDE: live task progress, diff preview, approve/reject buttons
tasks.notes: Self-build sidebar panel added to Monaco IDE: mode selector, start/stop, approve/reject, live log, approval row.

tasks.title: Self-build panel in VS extension: Arbiter self-build status and controls in VS tool window
tasks.notes: SelfBuildToolWindow in VSIX: dockable VS panel with mode selector, start/stop, approve/reject, live log.

tasks.title: Safety constraints: never push to remote without approval; protect config files in FullAuto mode
tasks.notes: BLOCKED_FILES list in core/self_build.py; /self-build/start mode parameter; protected files never auto-modified

tasks.title: Self-build session log: all generated diffs stored in AIEngine/ArbiterEngine/logs/self_build/
